title: Unsupported-fact catalog v1
description: Stable machine-readable catalog of unsupported fact classes (PLSP-SPEC-0038, #4770). The executable contract is the xtask unsupported_fact_catalog loader (slice 1) and the compiler-profile unsupported --check validator (slice 2).

class_id.description: Stable class ID (SPEC-0038 I1-I4). Profile-scoped classes carry the outside_profile suffix.

trigger_rule.description: Recognition rule, precise enough to implement.

compile_acceptance_blocks.description: Whether compile acceptance blocks on this class (SPEC-0038 E2: always explicit).

downstream_blocks.description: Whether downstream static facts block or require qualification (SPEC-0038 E2).

allowed_provider_behaviors.description: Subset of the 4-value provider behavior vocabulary. There is no exact behavior: provider exactness cannot bypass a blocking class (SPEC-0038 E3).

curated_gold_treatment.description: Expected curated-gold handling for the class.

profile_boundary_behavior.description: Executable-profile boundary behavior for the class.

owner_issue.description: Owning issue or permanent claim boundary.

not_dynamic_boundary.description: Why this class is not a DynamicBoundary disposition.

not_low_confidence.description: Why this class is not low confidence.

not_stale_evidence.description: Why this class is not stale evidence.

not_fallback.description: Why this class is not a provider fallback outcome.

nearest_neighbor.description: Nearest neighboring class ID (explicit separation target).

oracle_result_class.description: Shared with oracle_receipt.v1. The unknown result class projects to blocks_promotion, never to agreement, support, or known limitation (SPEC-0038 E1/P4).

introduced_in.description: Catalog version that introduced the class.

migrations.description: Migration records (rename/split/merge mappings per SPEC-0038 I1). Empty when the class never migrated.
